test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Seven friends, A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a straight line facing the same direction. E is sitting at one extreme end. E is sitting second to the left of C. B is sitting between C and A, whereas G and A are not sitting at any extreme end. F is seated immediately right of D. Who is seated in the middle?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) E is sitting at one extreme end.

2) E is sitting second to the left of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40e05a182bb285ef48b317f2803a7664a6676a20ce7972302630051c9ee4bb21.png] 

3) B is sitting between C and A, whereas G and A are not sitting at any extreme end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca8403d9e25f85354bca952bc7a082cdd73c93f6cadf3121e69c7c1125cb0b8f.png] 

4) F is seated immediately right of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e61b54cb068679a272c43f9eb13aae6e40c664909c135cb04cf5d5929104a46.png] 

Thus, the final arrangement is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f9d99923f241017f7d62d44426e73aa53bb39d92859b1aa19e28c2ee55fc92c.png] 

Here, we can see that B is sitting in the middle.

Hence, the correct answer is **"B"**.
